description: An accessory building for a residence at 2966 Mathers Avenue in West Vancouver's Altamont neighbourhood. Soren Rasmussen presented the design before the District of West Vancouver Board of Variance in October 2020.
One of the studio's final projects, it stands as evidence that the practice remained active into its fourth decade.
note: This page is a work in progress: only the public hearing record has been recovered so far.
